title: Draw an Opposite · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Draw an Opposite · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner writes a pair of opposites such as big and small. The lead draws two pictures showing the contrast without words. The group identifies both intended opposites. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Draw an Opposite, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group identifies both intended opposites.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group identifies both intended opposites.
